passing_drafts.title: Metaobject analytics queryable capability available in the Admin API
passing_drafts.post_text: Metaobject analyticsQueryable can now be set via GraphQL Admin API. Add a guard to check CAPABILITY_NOT_ELIGIBLE when enabling analytics. https://shopify.dev/changelog/posts/metaobject-analytics-queryable-capability-available-in-the-admin-api
passing_drafts.fact_sentence: Metaobject analyticsQueryable can now be set via GraphQL Admin API.
passing_drafts.rationale: The changelog explicitly lists the new input field for setting analyticsQueryable. The takeaway advises checking the error code CAPABILITY_NOT_ELIGIBLE, a documented guard that developers should handle.
passing_drafts.evidence_quote: graphql) Starting with GraphQL Admin API version `2027-01`, you can read and configure the `analyticsQueryable` capability on metaobject definitions.
passing_drafts.editorial_takeaway: Add a guard to check CAPABILITY_NOT_ELIGIBLE when enabling analytics.
